SITE INFORMATION

Privacy Policy

How we handle the information you choose to share.

Effective date: November 10, 2026

Information you provide

When you use our contact form, we receive the name, email address, service selection, and project details you submit. We use this information to respond to your inquiry and discuss possible services.

Website operations

Our hosting provider may process basic technical information, such as IP addresses and request logs, for security, performance, and delivery of this website. We do not use advertising trackers in this initial site build.

Storage and sharing

Form submissions are processed through our website hosting provider. We do not sell the personal information you provide. Information may be shared with service providers only as needed to operate the website or communicate with you.

Your choices

You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of information you submitted by contacting us through the contact page. We will review requests as applicable under relevant law.

Updates

We may revise this policy if our site practices change. The updated effective date will appear here.
